title: Generate API docs
description: Generates one JSON file per component with its props, for the docs app.

tsConfig.description: tsconfig for the package sources, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to <projectRoot>/tsconfig.lib.json.

include.description: Globs for component files, relative to the project root.

exclude.description: Globs to exclude, relative to the project root.

outputPath.description: Output directory, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to dist/api/<projectName>.

watch.description: Keep running and regenerate when sources change.
